scope: Seven base resource/sound archives treated as one unique namespace; no mount order, DLC/mod overrides, playback, RNG outcome or source lifetime proof.
units: Distance input values are multiplied by mutable spatial scale14776C0 (file initial20). Period inputs use the simulation-clock converter. Native constructor distances are explicitly distinguished from input values.
asset_inventory_scope: Only immediate .wav names/size/CRC from ZIP central directories. Per-directory digest is metadata, not a WAV-content hash or native iteration order.
